_note: Units a researcher has already worked and found nothing for, per field. Not a claim that nothing exists -- a record that a search was made and came back empty, so the next worklist does not spend an agent on it again. `gaps.js` excludes these from the worklists it builds; they still count as MISSING in the coverage figures, because they are. Remove an entry when a new source appears that the earlier search could not have seen.

fl.curriculumTime.BW|Botswana: both IBE editions contain no mention of any foreign language; BEC French JCE syllabus is assessment-only, no time allocation (2026-09)

fl.curriculumTime.GN|Guinea: IBE primary hours list contains no foreign language; college and lycee hour tables are images (2026-09)

fl.teacherSupply.BT|Bhutan: English is the medium of instruction and Dzongkha the national language, so neither is a foreign language here; no foreign-language teacher source found (2026-09)

he.linguistics.AO|Angola: UAN Faculdade de Humanidades, ISCED-Luanda and ISCED-Huila all checked; no degree named Linguistica, only language and literature degrees (2026-09)
he.linguistics.AS|American Samoa: ASCC is the only institution and its full 2024-2026 catalogue has no linguistics programme (2026-09)
he.linguistics.BI|Burundi: Universite du Burundi FLSH is five departments, none linguistics; Universite Lumiere offers none (2026-09)
he.linguistics.BW|Botswana: UB has no standalone linguistics degree; linguistics exists only as a named stream inside English and African Languages degrees (2026-09)
he.linguistics.CD|DR Congo: UNIKIN's 12 Lettres departments and UNILU's 9 are all languages, literature or communication; linguistics appears only as course titles (2026-09)
he.linguistics.CF|Central African Republic: Universite de Bangui's Institut de Linguistique Appliquee is a research and training body that names no degree and no level (2026-09)
he.linguistics.DJ|Djibouti: Universite de Djibouti FLLSH publishes its full offer as an image; no linguistics or sciences du langage degree in it (2026-09)
he.linguistics.ER|Eritrea: Adi-Keih offers Eritrean Languages and Literature, a language degree; EIT Mai Nefhi is science and engineering (2026-09)

he.policyHistory.CF|Central African Republic: CAR's dated language instruments are national language planning, not higher education; Loi 97/014 has no language article (2026-09)
he.policyHistory.CG|Congo: Loi 25/95 has no language-of-instruction article; the sgg.cg and unicongo copies are scans with no text layer (2026-09)
